name: Chhattisgarh
intro: India's widest waterfall, Bastar's caves, haats and dhokra craft, the early temples of Sirpur, Tala and Bhoramdeo, sal-forest tiger reserves and the Tibetan plateau of Mainpat. Check local advice before travelling deep into south Bastar.
